buffer_name.description: Buffer solution used during loading isotherm experiment

salt_name.description: Name/identity of the salt used in the mobile phase

process_run_id.description: Identifier of the automated process run (as stored in eLabFTW)

pump_speed.description: Pump speed used during loading and equilibration (unit as configured on system)

replicates.description: Number of replicate wells per (salt, ligand) condition

total_volume_uL.description: Total liquid volume per well used for incubation

venting_time_s.description: Venting time for automated system steps

pump_duration_s.description: Duration of the pump step during loading/equilibration

incubation_time_min.description: Incubation time of resin with ligand solution

salt_concentrations.description: List of salt concentrations used in the experiment (as provided in eLabFTW). Parsed from semicolon/comma-separated values where possible.

equilibration_volume_uL.description: Volume used for each equilibration cycle

ligand_concentrations.description: List of ligand concentrations used in the experiment (as provided in eLabFTW). Parsed from semicolon/comma-separated values where possible.

measurement_wavelength_nm.description: Measurement wavelength used by the Tecan plate reader

calibration_curve_slope.description: Slope of the calibration curve used to convert absorbance to concentration

salt_concentration_unit.description: Unit of the salt concentrations (e.g. mM)

salt_stock_concentration.description: Stock concentration of the salt solution

ligand_concentration_unit.description: Unit of the ligand concentrations (e.g. µM, mM)

ligand_stock_concentration.description: Stock concentration of the ligand solution

calibration_curve_intercept.description: Intercept of the calibration curve used to convert absorbance to concentration

n_salt_concentrations.description: Number of distinct salt concentrations used

n_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of distinct ligand concentrations used

analysis_status.description: Status of the Tecan loading isotherm analysis

timestamp.description: Timestamp at which results were committed to the database

analysis_results.description: Raw analysis_results JSON produced by the analysis script (analysis_results_<id>.json)

summary.description: Summary metrics extracted from Langmuir fits and aggregation results

n_salt_conditions.description: Number of distinct salt concentrations with Langmuir fits

n_ligand_conditions.description: Number of distinct ligand concentrations used in analysis

n_points_total.description: Total number of (salt, ligand) data points fitted (n_salt_conditions * n_ligand_conditions)

qmax_values.description: List of fitted qmax values per salt concentration (may include nulls if fit failed)

K_values.description: List of fitted Langmuir K values per salt concentration (may include nulls if fit failed)

r2_values.description: List of R^2 values of Langmuir fits per salt concentration (may include nulls if fit failed)

mean_qmax.description: Mean of all non-null qmax values

mean_r2.description: Mean of all non-null R^2 values

data_files.description: Structured paths to result data files (CSV, Excel and JSON)

tecan_raw_file.description: Path to downloaded Tecan raw Excel file

warnings.description: Any warnings generated during analysis (copied from analysis_results JSON if present)
